geography_note: State geography is assigned directly from Grantee State. County/county-equivalent matches combine high-confidence direct county text with the primary county listed for a conservatively matched city/place. City/place geography uses point locations from the supplied U.S. cities database and is not a municipal-boundary layer. A city-derived county is an approximation for places that span more than one county. The 2010 Census urban-area layer is retained as a secondary analytical geography and is linked by matched city point-in-polygon where possible.
city_data_attribution: City/place coordinates and primary-county attributes are derived from the user-supplied SimpleMaps U.S. Cities database. The free database requires visible SimpleMaps attribution.
deployment_runtime: Static HTML/CSS/JavaScript on GitHub Pages; no server required
static_finance_storage: Dictionary-encoded quarter-level rows split into JavaScript chunks and loaded in the browser
quick_report_mode: Single-area or two-scenario one-page decision report with map, trend, top-five ranking, key takeaways, and aggregate exports
report_export_note: Reports are generated entirely in the browser and can be downloaded as PNG, printed/saved as a one-page PDF, or exported as aggregate CSV.
